Hi Dana — thanks for the attendee list. Happy to run an exec-focused walkthrough. Two quick asks before I propose concrete times:

1) Will all three exec groups (CTO/Head Ops/Head Prod) need to be present for the same hour, or would you prefer a 45-minute exec demo + 30-minute breakout for region-specific Q&A?
2) Are there any hard blackout days for the NA execs next week?

Proposed approach (to avoid everyone suffering at midnight):
- Option A: Rotating 90-minute session that starts at a time that slices across regions (e.g., 16:00 UTC) so NA gets late morning/early afternoon, EU gets late morning, APAC gets late evening.
- Option B: Two-part run: 45-minute exec demo timed for NA/EU overlap + 30-minute APAC-focused follow-up the same day (APAC joins whole session or just later Q&A).

Note about DST: EU transitions off DST on the last weekend of October this year (Oct 31). US changes are in early November. If you plan a recurring cadence or a multi-week proof series, we should flag this now so calendar invites aren’t misaligned after the EU switch.

I can propose specific slots once you confirm the preferred format. If helpful, my team has an availability CSV — I’ll attach it now.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

- We prefer Option B (45-minute exec + 30-minute APAC follow-up). Keeps exec time compact and gives APAC a focused block.
- Procurement (Samir) may join the breakouts; he will likely bring contract timeline questions.
